implemented.workflow_runtime: single-process deterministic executor with local SQLite checkpoints and structured events
implemented.state_and_memory: local SQLite implementations plus in-memory test adapters
implemented.configuration: validated environment settings for implemented local backends
implemented.research_to_publish_mvp: fixture/fake sources remain the default; opt-in research.collect.https uses pre-registered source IDs, exact HTTPS host allowlists, public-IP and redirect revalidation, DNS-pinned stdlib TLS, timeout/byte/type limits, and normalized URL/timestamp/SHA-256 provenance. The deterministic draft, claim review, explicit human approval, local Markdown artifacts, and opt-in GitHub publisher seams remain unchanged
implemented.demo: agos research-to-publish-demo; it performs no network access or external publishing

planned.production_github_client_and_other_publi: planned; require explicit egress controls, secret references, ambiguous-outcome recovery, audit retention, and human authorization

limitations: No HTTP API, scheduler, queue, remote workers, credential lookup, or general-purpose network client is implemented. The opt-in HTTPS research connector is the only bundled live retrieval path and is capability/allowlist constrained; the GitHub Markdown adapter is an injected interface exercised with fakes only.

Source connectors are fixture/fake by default. Opt-in HTTPS research accepts only exact allowlisted hosts and pre-registered IDs; it rejects non-public destinations and revalidates redirects, uses no credentials/cookies, and is fake-tested without live web access.
Human approval is represented by an explicit workflow input in this local MVP; no interactive approval service is implemented.
SQLite is single-host storage and does not make tool side effects transactional or provide distributed exactly-once recovery.
The supplied container manifest is for local tooling, not a production topology.
